scripts.text:
You can read on the back of the statue:
'By the spirit of olds, the walls are closed
Upper floors or foreign taboo
By the order of the Statues you will find the way
Which perhaps a day will bring you to me.
.....Thanatos '
scripts.translation:
雕像背面刻著：
“古老的靈魂封閉了牆壁，
高層禁地不容外人踏入。
遵循雕像的指引，便能找到道路，
或許有一天，你會來到我面前。
... 薩納托斯”

scripts.text:
[Thalos]
You must find the 2nd Statue now.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛斯]
你現在必須找到第二座雕像。

scripts.text:
[Thalos]
Go search the 2nd Statue!
scripts.translation:
[塔洛斯]
去找第二座雕像吧！

scripts.text:
[Mediane]
Okay, i am warping you to the next floor now.
scripts.translation:
[梅迪安]
好的，我現在將你傳送到下一層。

scripts.text:
[Mediane]
You must talk with the Spirit in the 1st Statue.
scripts.translation:
[梅迪安]
你必須先與第一座雕像中的靈魂交談。

scripts.text:
[Melkor]
You must find the other Spirits now.
We are 3.
scripts.translation:
[米爾寇]
現在去找其他靈魂吧。
我們一共有三個。

scripts.text:
[Melkor]
Go Search, They are in this floor.
scripts.translation:
[米爾寇]
去找吧，他們就在這一層。

scripts.text:
[Zebrus]
Keep on this way, There is one Spirit left
scripts.translation:
[澤布魯斯]
繼續努力，還剩一個靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Zebrus]
You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Melkor.
scripts.translation:
[澤布魯斯]
你似乎迷路了，回去找米爾寇談談。

scripts.text:
[Veriaelle]
Okay, i am warping you to the next floor.
scripts.translation:
[維裡艾勒]
好的，我現在將你傳送到下一層。

scripts.text:
[Veriaelle]
You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Melkor.
scripts.translation:
[維裡艾勒]
你似乎迷路了，回去找米爾寇談談。

scripts.text:
[Throtre]
You got my authorization for the next floor
However, you must show how strong you are to the other Spirits
scripts.translation:
[斯羅特雷]
我允許你前往下一層了。
不過，你還得向其他靈魂證明自己的實力。

scripts.text:
[Throtre]
Go search, They Can't leave this floor.
scripts.translation:
[斯羅特雷]
去找吧，他們無法離開這一層。

scripts.text:
[Klermaz]
Hmm it seems that Throtre allowed you to pass.
Well then you have my blessing, 2 Spirits remaining.
scripts.translation:
[克萊爾馬茲]
嗯，看來斯羅特雷已經允許你通行了。
那麼，你也得到了我的祝福，還剩兩個靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Klermaz]
You seems to be lost, Go back and talk to Throtre.
scripts.translation:
[克萊爾馬茲]
你似乎迷路了，回去找斯羅特雷談談。

scripts.text:
[Mihane]
Keep on this way, Only 1 Left.
scripts.translation:
[米哈內]
繼續努力，只剩一個了。

scripts.text:
[Mihane]
Sorry, You must start over from the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[米哈內]
抱歉，你必須從頭開始。

scripts.text:
[Seranes]
Perfect, it seems that the other spirits grants you the access.
I am warping you to the next floor.
scripts.translation:
[塞拉內斯]
很好，看來其他靈魂已經允許你通行了。
我這就送你去下一層。

scripts.text:
[Seranes]
You did not follow the good order, starts again from the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[塞拉內斯]
順序不對，請從頭開始。

scripts.text:
[Nox]
Fine, 4 Spirits left.
scripts.translation:
[諾克斯]
很好，還剩四個靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Nox]
Go search, They can't leave this floor.
scripts.translation:
[諾克斯]
去找吧，他們無法離開這一層。

scripts.text:
[Vox]
Keep on this way, 3 Spirits remaining !
scripts.translation:
[沃克斯]
繼續努力，還剩三個靈魂！

scripts.text:
[Vox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Nox.
scripts.translation:
[沃克斯]
抱歉，請回去找諾克斯。

scripts.text:
[Hox]
You are on the good way, 2 Spirits remaining !
scripts.translation:
[霍克斯]
你做得沒錯，還剩兩個靈魂！

scripts.text:
[Hox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Vox.
scripts.translation:
[霍克斯]
抱歉，請回去找沃克斯。

scripts.text:
[Dox]
Perfect, 1 Spirit left.
scripts.translation:
[多克斯]
很好，只剩一個靈魂了。

scripts.text:
[Dox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Hox.
scripts.translation:
[多克斯]
抱歉，請回去找霍克斯。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
You have just passed the test successfully.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
你已經順利通過了考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
You have to give me Red Magic Stone, Yellow Magic Stone, Blue Magic Stone & Green Magic Stone.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
你需要給我紅色魔法之石、黃色魔法之石、藍色魔法之石和綠色魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
I will now warp you to steps of Fate.
Good-bye.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
我現在將你傳送到命運之階。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
Oh well, seems you don't have enough stones.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
唉，看來你沒有帶夠魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Sox]
Sorry, Go back and talk to Dox.
scripts.translation:
[索克斯]
抱歉，請回去找多克斯。
